# NPR StateImpact Idaho

> > In-depth reporting on Idaho state government, public policy, and workforce issues affecting the state.

StateImpact Idaho is an NPR project providing investigative journalism and data-driven coverage of Idaho's legislature, state employee compensation, budget decisions, and regional policy comparisons with neighboring western states.

## Key Topics

- Idaho Legislature
- State employee compensation
- Office of Performance Evaluations
- Division of Human Resources
- Workforce studies
- Wage comparison
- Government pay
- Idaho public policy
- Western states comparison (Arizona, Colorado, Montana, New Mexico, Nevada, Utah, Washington, Wyoming)
- State budget and employment
- Legislative analysis

## State Government & Policy

- [2013 January | StateImpact Idaho](https://stateimpact.npr.org/idaho/2013/01/): Archive of Idaho news from January 2013 on state employment and budget
